newsitem.title: USA: Ameristar lowers Q3 EPS expectations.
newsitem.headline: Ameristar lowers Q3 EPS expectations.

text.p: Ameristar Casinos Inc Friday said it has lowered its earnings per share expectations for the third and fourth quarters by half of analysts' previous estimates.
Analysts had estimated earnings of $0.23 to $0.27 per share for the third quarter ending September 30 and earnings of $0.10 to $0.18 per share for the fourth quarter ending December 31.
Ameristar said it estimates earnings for the third and fourth quarters will fall between $0.09 and $0.13 and $0.07 and $0.1O per share, respectively.
